tagline: Plucked-string sitar voice with sympathetic strings
description: A six-voice plucked-string instrument: a noise burst excites a tuned feedback delay (Karplus-Strong), a soft clipper adds bridge buzz, and 13 further tuned delays ring along as sympathetic strings. Use it for sitar-like melodic lines and drones.

features.name: Jawari
features.description: Blends in tanh soft clipping of the string output for a buzzing, brighter tone.

features.name: Sympathetic strings
features.description: 13 resonators fed by the main string, tuned to the played note in a Chromatic, Bhairavi, Yaman or Kafi scale.

features.name: Drone
features.description: Two resonators at C3 and G3, plucked every 4 and 5 seconds, so they are heard only on notes held that long.

features.name: Pitch and vibrato
features.description: Pitch Bend from -2 to +2 semitones and sine vibrato up to 10 Hz and 5% depth.

features.name: Attack
features.description: Fade-in from 1 to 100 ms; the Decay control is read but not used by the engine.
